openClinicalQuestions: Which readiness checks does Dr. Zalak Shah use before return to running or impact?
Which postnatal bleeding and wound changes should Dr. Charmi Shah classify as prompt versus emergency?
How should advice differ after assisted vaginal birth and C-section?

claimLedger.claim: Postnatal activity should return gradually and be adjusted to birth recovery and symptoms.
claimLedger.limitations: General guidance cannot clear an individual for impact exercise.

claimLedger.claim: Pelvic-floor, abdominal and musculoskeletal symptoms can inform postnatal exercise progression.
claimLedger.limitations: Patient guidance requires clinician interpretation for each birth and complication history.
